caption:
Before you go to sleep tonight, remember this

#usa #newyork #american
transcript: Before you go to sleep tonight, remember this, nothing drains your energy more than fighting battles inside your own mind, thinking about things you cannot control, replaying conversations, worrying about tomorrow, let it go for tonight. You did what you could today, you handled what was in front of you. That is enough. Give your mind permission to rest. The world can wait until morning. Close your eyes with a little peace in your chest. You're going to be okay.
